products.summary: A 100 W three-port USB-C GaN charger about the size of an AirPods case, with a colour screen that shows the watts each port is giving; it is $59.99 at Baseus's US store. Any one port gives 100 W alone, and it supports USB PD 3.2 with AVS (9–20 V) and PPS (5–20 V at up to 5 A), per techtest.org's port readout. Smartzone measured 93% efficiency at 100 W and a drop to 80 W after 45 minutes of full load, with 67 W + 30 W across two ports in the default mode.
products.fit: Suits someone who wants one small charger for a laptop, a phone and earbuds, and who wants to see what each port delivers; Smartzone says its AVS support charges the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max at full power. Anyone who needs USB-A or a larger laptop share with several devices plugged in is better served by the UGREEN Nexode 100W 4-Port GaN Charger ($54.99). Anyone who wants a display and more than 100 W should look at the UGREEN Nexode Pro 160W 5-Port ($56.99 with the code on our link), which has two 140 W ports.
caveats: Total output is 100 W shared, and reviewers' tables disagree: with two devices the laptop port gets 67 W in Smart Mode or 80 W in Turbo Mode per Smartzone, while techtest.org lists 45 W + 45 W.
Smartzone found that USB-C2 and USB-C3 used together share 15 W at 5 V, so a laptop belongs on USB-C1.
It does not hold 100 W indefinitely: techtest.org saw 80 W after about 40 minutes, and Smartzone saw 80 W after 45 minutes with the housing at 67 °C.
There is no USB-A port and no built-in cable. Android Authority's reviewer found the included USB-C cable too short and bought longer ones.
Device recognition and the charge-to-95% power-off feature work only with iPhone 15 and newer, and the temperature page shows a bar rather than degrees (Smartzone).
The techtest.org and Smartzone figures come from German reviews, so their units were probably the EU-plug version; neither figure set was checked against Baseus's US page.
No discount at Baseus's store today: price and compare-at price are both $59.99. The Dark Cherry Edition is a separate listing at the same price.
Returns are short: 7 business days without a reason, buyer pays shipping, 30 business days for a defect; warranty is 18–24 months (Baseus US pages, read 2026-11-27).
